info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Expires-v4-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Expiration Lookup API provides functionality to retrieve information about loyalty program expirations. This endpoint allows businesses to monitor and manage loyalty points that are nearing their expiration date, enabling proactive customer engagement strategies. Typical consumers include loyalty program managers and customer support representatives who need insights into customer loyalty status. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer retention efforts and optimize their loyalty programs.

get.description: Fetch the details of loyalty points that have reached their expiration date. This endpoint helps users understand which points are no longer available for redemption, ensuring they can maximize their benefits.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required to expire a loyalty program membership or points. Please ensure that the provided data complies with the expected schema to avoid errors.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current loyalty expiration data.
